apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: postgres
spec:
  replicas: 1
  strategy:
    type: Recreate
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: postgres
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: postgres
    spec:
      containers:
        - name: postgres
          image: postgres:18
          env:
            - name: POSTGRES_PASSWORD
              valueFrom:
                secretKeyRef:
                  name: db-secret
                  key: POSTGRES_PASSWORD
          volumeMounts:
            - name: data
              mountPath: /var/lib/postgresql
      volumes:
        - name: data
          persistentVolumeClaim:
            claimName: hitokoto-data
---
apiVersion: v1
kind: Service
metadata:
  name: postgres
spec:
  selector:
    app: postgres
  ports:
    - port: 5432

apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: hitokoto
spec:
  replicas: 3
  selector:
    matchLabels:
      app: hitokoto
  template:
    metadata:
      labels:
        app: hitokoto
    spec:
      containers:
        - name: app
          image: ghcr.io/container-nyumon/hitokoto:2.1
          env:
            - name: APP_TITLE
              valueFrom:
                configMapKeyRef:
                  name: hitokoto-config
                  key: APP_TITLE
            - name: DB_HOST
              value: postgres
            - name: DB_PASSWORD
              valueFrom:
                secretKeyRef:
                  name: db-secret
                  key: POSTGRES_PASSWORD
          volumeMounts:
            - name: config
              mountPath: /etc/hitokoto
      volumes:
        - name: config
          configMap:
            name: hitokoto-config
